launch_blockers: Create or confirm the dedicated Facebook Page mirror identity.
Record Page URL, handle, and admin ownership.
Confirm Page ID, Page access token, app permissions, and app-review requirements.
Run the non-posting Facebook Page probe against the actual Page.
Complete payload and Page identity launch review before any live post.
Confirm Instagram account type and profile/user ID.
Confirm Meta app permissions for publishing to the mirror account.
Confirm token lifetime, refresh route, and app-review requirements.
Run the non-posting Instagram profile probe against the actual account.
Complete dry-run payload and account identity launch review before any live post.

shared_guardrails: Do not post under a personal Meta, Instagram, or Facebook profile.
Keep platform delivery state separate from Bluesky, Threads, and X.
Start with new forward posts only; historical replay requires a separate reviewed decision.
Enable each platform only after its probe, dry run, launch review, and controlled first-post verification pass.
